title: Detailed planet with rings
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='planetGrad' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffcc66'/>
      <stop offset='40%' stop-color='#e8a030'/>
      <stop offset='75%' stop-color='#cc7722'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#994411'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='bandGrad1' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffdd88' stop-opacity='0.5'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#cc8833' stop-opacity='0.2'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='ringGrad' x1='0%' y1='0%' x2='100%' y2='0%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#88ddff' stop-opacity='0.1'/>
      <stop offset='15%' stop-color='#aaddff' stop-opacity='0.7'/>
      <stop offset='30%' stop-color='#66ccff' stop-opacity='0.3'/>
      <stop offset='45%' stop-color='#bbeeff' stop-opacity='0.8'/>
      <stop offset='55%' stop-color='#88ddff' stop-opacity='0.4'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#aaddff' stop-opacity='0.7'/>
      <stop offset='85%' stop-color='#66ccff' stop-opacity='0.3'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#bbeeff' stop-opacity='0.1'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Back ring (behind planet) -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='46' ry='13' fill='none' stroke='#88ddff' stroke-width='3' opacity='0.4' transform='rotate(-20 50 52)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='40' ry='10' fill='none' stroke='#aaddff' stroke-width='2' opacity='0.3' transform='rotate(-20 50 52)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='52' ry='16' fill='none' stroke='#66ccff' stroke-width='2' opacity='0.25' transform='rotate(-20 50 52)'/>

  <!-- Planet body -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='28' fill='url(#planetGrad)'/>

  <!-- Planet bands (atmospheric stripes) -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='27' ry='5' fill='#ffcc55' opacity='0.45'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='28' ry='4' fill='#ddaa44' opacity='0.35'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='28' ry='3.5' fill='#ffdd77' opacity='0.3'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='27' ry='6' fill='#cc8822' opacity='0.4'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='63' rx='24' ry='4' fill='#aa6611' opacity='0.35'/>

  <!-- Great spot (like Jupiter's but orange) -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='55' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#cc5511' opacity='0.6'/>
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='55' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#ff7722' opacity='0.4'/>

  <!-- Highlight / lit side -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='28' fill='url(#bandGrad1)' opacity='0.3'/>
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='42' rx='10' ry='8' fill='#ffeebb' opacity='0.2'/>

  <!-- Front ring (in front of planet) -->
  <!-- Inner ring band -->
  <path d='M 8,58 Q 30,45 50,46 Q 70,47 92,58' fill='none' stroke='#aaddff' stroke-width='3.5' opacity='0.7'/>
  <path d='M 12,60 Q 32,48 50,49 Q 68,50 88,60' fill='none' stroke='#88ddff' stroke-width='2' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- Outer thin ring -->
  <path d='M 3,55 Q 28,41 50,42 Q 72,43 97,55' fill='none' stroke='#bbeeff' stroke-width='2.5' opacity='0.55'/>
  <!-- Gap between rings visible -->
  <path d='M 5,57 Q 29,44 50,45 Q 71,46 95,57' fill='none' stroke='#66ccff' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.3'/>

  <!-- Ring shine highlights -->
  <path d='M 20,54 Q 35,47 50,47' fill='none' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.5'/>
  <path d='M 50,47 Q 65,48 80,55' fill='none' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.4'/>

  <!-- Sparkle stars -->
  <g fill='#ffffff'>
    <circle cx='20' cy='30' r='1.2' opacity='0.9'/>
    <circle cx='78' cy='25' r='1' opacity='0.7'/>
    <circle cx='85' cy='72' r='1.3' opacity='0.8'/>
    <circle cx='15' cy='75' r='0.9' opacity='0.6'/>
    <circle cx='65' cy='80' r='1' opacity='0.7'/>
    <circle cx='28' cy='18' r='0.8' opacity='0.5'/>
    <circle cx='72' cy='68' r='0.7' opacity='0.5'/>
    <circle cx='45' cy='22' r='0.9' opacity='0.6'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Cross sparkle -->
  <g stroke='#aaddff' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.8'>
    <line x1='22' y1='28' x2='22' y2='32'/>
    <line x1='20' y1='30' x2='24' y2='30'/>
  </g>
</svg>
